_meta.description: Receives the MeetSum 'action_item.created' webhook (payload v2), verifies the signature and creates a Todoist task with a link back to the meeting.
setup: 3. Copy the production webhook URL from the Webhook node

4. In MeetSum, Settings → Integrations → Webhooks (or POST /api/webhooks/subscriptions { url: '<webhook-url>', events: ['action_item.created'], payloadVersion: 2 }): create a v2 subscription and copy the secret (shown once)

5. Set the n8n environment variable MEETSUM_WEBHOOK_SECRET to the subscription secret shown once by MeetSum (allow env access in Code nodes, or paste the secret into the 'Verify MeetSum signature' node).
